title: Bevel Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 4.5 LTS Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: The modifier is a non-destructive alternative to the Edit Mode Bevel operation

On uniform cylinder and taper fixtures, Harden Normals restored curved-side analytic error to the unbeveled baseline; on an uneven equal-count circle it preserved the baseline's existing 5-degree topology error rather than concealing it
candidate_principles: Use Angle limiting when coplanar triangulation edges should not be beveled

Inspect minimum edge length and corner quality even when Clamp Overlap is enabled

title: Weighted Normal Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 4.5-era latest Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: Weighted Normal creates custom per-corner normals using face area, corner angle, or their product
Keep Sharp preserves sharp-edge boundaries and Face Influence consumes weak, medium, or strong face strengths
On a matched Blender 5.2 flat-panel fixture, Bevel Face Strength AFFECTED followed by Weighted Normal Face Influence reduced maximum large-panel corner-normal error from 10.5605 degrees to zero

On uniform radial/taper fixtures the same stack kept curved-side analytic error below 0.024 degrees, but on an uneven equal-count 12-sided circle it increased side error from a 5.0-degree unbeveled baseline to 9.9988 degrees
candidate_principles: Place Weighted Normal after the modifier that authors the face strengths it consumes
Use custom normals to correct interpolation on suitable flat panels, never as a substitute for geometric or topological repair
Inspect curved regions independently and reject face-area weighting when uneven panel distribution increases analytic or visual error

title: Modeling a Sci-Fi Crate in Blender | Box Modeling Fundamentals
creator: CG Cookie - Learn Blender

direct_observations: The lesson starts from the default cube, deletes three quarters, and uses live X/Y Mirror symmetry for a connected primary shell.
Panel seams and the handle cavity are created by face edits; the handle inset disables Boundary at the mirror seam.
Latch and bumper assemblies are fitted by duplicating source faces before separating them at real assembly boundaries.
candidate_principles: Prefer connected edits for shell-owned recesses and duplicate fitted faces only when a real assembly boundary justifies separation.
Keep symmetry, thickness, and edge treatment live until the cage and visible proportions survive review.
limitations: The reproduction scored 6.8/10 and does not pass I0.
Independent browser screenshot capture timed out, and the retained thumbnail obscures the final model with title graphics.
The curved-shell transfer validates one construction principle, not complete prop fidelity.
